name: EZH inhibitory protein

function.text: EZHIP encodes EZH inhibitory protein. Annotated molecular activities include histone methyltransferase inhibitor activity. It participates in chromatin organization and epigenetic regulation of gene expression.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: EZHIP overexpression is associated with posterior fossa group A ependymoma and can inhibit PRC2-mediated H3K27 methylation. This expression-associated mechanism does not establish pathogenicity of an arbitrary EZHIP sequence variant.
